Power 
 Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document 
 lists the equipment inspection I1, which must be performed on yearly bases as 
 indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The first 
 draft initiated by eng. Ahmed Abel Halim Elangger and reviewed bay eng. 
 Mohamed Salah Badawy accepted by eng. Abdel Rahem Salam general director and 
 approved by eng. Mohamed Enan Head sector of Damietta power station
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety 
shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses.
A work permit must be issued, the qualified maintenance staff must carry the 
suitable ID safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area.
Wear appropriate personal protective equipment must be used, safety 
shoes, helmet breathing mask, safety glasses.
The unit must be 
 out of service
Disconnect the circuit breaker and the ground shoe
Tools 
and Equipment
Complete tool set
Digital voltmeter.
Megger
Brushes
Work to be 
carried out
Step | Work to be carried out | Setting reference value | Result
1 | Clean the mating surface of the metal clad | ok - not ok | 
2 | Check the control voltage value at source of power and line 
 drop between the power source and breaker | 220 VDC | 
3 | Check the racking mechanism to make certain that it is in 
 the disconnect position | ok - not ok | 
4 | Close the CB manually | ok - not ok | 
5 | Open CB manual manually | ok - not ok | 
6 | Check charging and discharging of the CB | ok - not ok | 
7 | Check the closing time of breaker | 0.6-0.1 sec | 
8 | Check the tripping time of breaker | 0.25-0.3 sec | 
9 | Checked the primary circuit insulation on the breaker phase 
 to phase to ground | ok - not ok | 
10 | Check the DC resistance | 100 Ω | 
11 | Lubricate the breaker operating mechanism | ok - not ok | 
12 | Check the painting of CB and accessories | ok - not ok | 
13 | Clean the disconnecting switch for the auxiliary transformer | ok - not ok | 
14 | Check the disconnecting switch for the auxiliary transformer | ok - not ok |

أعد المسودة الأولى م. Ahmed Abel Halim Elangger، وراجعها م. Mohamed Salah Badawy، وقبلها م. Abdel Rahem Salam، المدير العام، واعتمدها م. Mohamed Enan، رئيس قطاع محطة كهرباء دمياط.
يجب إصدار أمر شغل، ويجب أن يحمل طاقم الصيانة المؤهل فئة السلامة المناسبة.
